column1: # Components this repo still ships a class for, and should not be used on new work.
# A component gets a row here when Figma has MOVED ON but the class stays — a rename plus a
# redesign, a superseded pattern — and the decision was to keep both rather than break the
# pages using the old one. Without this the two classes sit side by side in components.css
# looking equally current, which is how a page picks the stale one by accident.
# This is NOT the file for a component Figma has deleted; that is gone-components.tsv, and a
# `retired` verdict there means the class has already gone. A row here means the class SHIPS.
# build-components-css.mjs reads it, writes the notice into the class's own comment block, and
# counts and names every row in its verdict line. It FAILS on a row naming a component with no
# rules, or a supersededBy with no rules — a deprecation pointing at nothing is worse than none.

column6: One Figma node, renamed AND redesigned: a 48px pill became a 65px bordered tab. Both measurements are captured and three prototypes still render the pill. Decision was keep-both — ship the current design, keep the old class, mark it.
